aio-pika-iterator-channel-close.review_basis: The patch adds a message-or-closed event and explicit StopAsyncIteration branches. Existing and added AMQP iterator tests supply source-relevant verification; runtime channel state remains unestablished by syntax.

aio-pika-iterator-cleanup-timeout.review_basis: The new test_context_cancels_expired_cleanup and repeated-cancellation regression check cancellation and closure. Existing robust iterator reconnection tests remain the before verifier candidate.

aio-pika-iterator-nack-scope.review_basis: test_regression_only_messages_cancelled_subscription_are_nacked exercises two subscriptions; the patch changes multiple=True to False and iterates buffered messages.

aio-pika-processing-channel-close.review_basis: The before integration tests exercise message.process/requeue. New after unit tests assert original-error identity, no acknowledgement, no rejected closed-channel delivery and propagation of other reject errors.

aiokafka-commit-refresh-order.review_basis: The exact clear() call moves before _maybe_refresh_commit_offsets in source. This is physical source order, not a runtime happens-before claim. Existing commit-refresh tests are relevant but are not claimed to cover this race.

aiokafka-commit-timeout.review_basis: The changed error tuple nominates RequestTimedOutError for coordinator invalidation. Existing test_commit_failed_scenarios exercises commit failures. No new dedicated upstream regression was added.

aiokafka-commit-unknown-member.review_basis: The upstream regression extends test_coordinator__maybe_do_autocommit with UnknownMemberIdError and asserts the retry-backoff timeout.

aiokafka-join-autocommit-error.review_basis: The after revision adds test_coordinator_ensure_active_group_on_expired_membership, preserving the explicit commit error while allowing group preparation to finish.

faststream-ack-cancellation.review_basis: The patch adds an explicit asyncio.CancelledError case. New Kafka cancellation tests and shared consume coverage distinguish cancellation from normal message completion. Before-stage source review nominates TestAckPolicy.test_commit_called_in_middleware_on_error: it includes ACK and REJECT_ON_ERROR, raises a handler Exception and asserts commit was awaited. This is existing ordinary-error acknowledgement coverage, not cancellation/redelivery proof. The original shared consume file remains context. The after test starts an interrupted handler, restarts the broker and asserts the payload is redelivered. Exact test ranges bind both stages; runtime outcomes remain outside observer authority.

faststream-ack-error.review_basis: Existing pushback tests assert ack/reject counts and watcher memory. The patch catches acknowledgement errors and moves watcher removal to the else block; no dedicated new upstream test was added.

faststream-batch-nack.review_basis: The new test_message_nack_seek asserts seek is called through the test consumer. The source now chooses the first tuple member before obtaining topic/partition/offset. Runtime broker delivery is not certified. Before-stage verifier review: TestConsume.test_nack explicitly awaits msg.nack() and asserts commit was not called; it is relevant existing negative-acknowledgement coverage, not proof of batch seek correctness. The seek regression exists only after the change. The original before test_test_client.py nomination had no nack/seek test and is preserved in oracle-review-01/original-grader.json with the original failed acquisitions.

faststream-consumer-commit-failure.review_basis: The patch changes the explicit asynchronous keyword and catches the no-offset error before close. Existing Confluent consume tests enter/exit the broker; no exact commit-failure coverage is asserted.

faststream-empty-batch-publisher.review_basis: The genuine upstream change normalizes empty batch bodies before the nominated publication call. New Kafka test-client assertions cover None and empty results. Static call syntax does not prove encoded payload compatibility.
